question: For the people wondering, it's about time we put an end to the question of who the person on the cover of chapter 631 is! Is it the "Golden Lion" Shiki? Or the "Left Hand of the Pirate King" Scopper Gaban?
answer: You've got a good memory! That was Gaban. He wandered around quite a bit. He never gave up being a sailor; he is a navigator, after all.
name: Ebi
